Full-development 120 paths; fixed target 45/5/50, technical η=0.03, original H=30 and L=40%.
Known fees enter actual and forecast calculations. No cost misestimation, refit or admission test is performed.
Current C remains Review; these are archived research outcomes, not served investment returns.
